test_title: PYST 66: SSC GD Constable 2022 - Reasoning (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question: A, B, C, D, and E are five students sitting around a circular table facing the centre. D sits to the immediate right of A. C is not sitting next to D or A. E is sitting to the immediate right of C. Who is sitting to the immediate right of D?
solution:
Given: A, B, C, D, and E are five students sitting around a circular table facing the centre.

1) D sits to the immediate right of A.

2) C is not sitting next to D or A.

3) E is sitting to the immediate right of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/621cb6b96232da9c5281f1868f5d625dd5e66c64d40da19c7d3a1f1454efdb3c.png] 

And, B will sit at the remaining place.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/649e78e3746ef4c208c56057f0bca183ab5c63a36cd17a4e3ee274843c450b8c.png] 

Here, B is sitting to the immediate right of D.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
